source: 638 Possible Enemy
target: 638 Inimicus Possibilis

source: “My father bore the last name Andariel, cut down by a curse unleashed by a Devil’s projection during a ritual gone awry.
target: “Pater meus nomen Andariel gerebat, occisus maledictione efferata ex projectione diaboli in ritu aberrante.

source: “Inheriting his mantle, I became a Beyonder.
target: “Mantellum eius hereditans, factus sum transmundanus.

source: “My mother remains a mystery, perhaps just another name etched into my father’s ledger of victims…
target: “Mater mea manet mysterium, fortasse solum aliud nomen in tabula victimarum patris mei insculptum…

source: “Upon the murky surface of a dark mirror, Bram Andariel’s blood-drained visage recounted his origins with an impassive mask.
target: “Super turbidam superficiem speculi obscuri, vultus exsanguis Bram Andariel, cum larva impassibili, originem suam enarravit.

source: “Franca, ‘invited’ by Lumian, faced a full-body mirror, employing her unique magic mirror spirit channeling technique to delve into the Andariel family and the Rose School of Thought.
target: “Franca, a Lumiano “invitata”, speculo totius corporis intuebatur, technicam magicam speculi et spiritus transmittendi singularem adhibens ad perscrutandam familiam Andariel atque Schola Rosi Cogitationis.

source: “Regrettably, Bram lingered on the fringes of the secret organization and his Devilish family. His insights were scant.
target: “Infeliciter, Bram in marginibus organizationis secretae et familiae diaboli suae moratus est. Perspicaciae eius parvae erant.

source: “Moreover, to divert Lumian’s scrutiny and covertly finalize the ritual preparations, he divulged truths without deceit.
target: “Praeterea, ut scrutinium Lumiani avertiret et occulte praeparationes ritualis compleret, veritates sine dolo divulgavit.

source: “With Spirit Channeling reaching its threshold, Franca posed a final query.
target: “Cum potentia spiritus transmittendi ad apicem pervenisset, Franca quaestionem ultimam proposuit.

source: “Who leads the Andariel family now?”
target: “Quis nunc familiam Andariel ducit?”

source: “Bram’s increasingly translucent and sinister countenance contorted abruptly.
target: “Vultus Bram, magis translucens et sinistrus, subito in contorsionem versa est.

source: “He—he’s dead.
target: “Ipse – mortuus est.

source: “He became a sacrifice!”
target: “Factus est sacrificium!”

source: “Sacrifice… such theatricality?”
target: “Sacrificium… talis theatralitas?”

source: “Before Franca could delve deeper, Bram’s figure waned swiftly, dissipating into nothingness.
target: “Antequam Franca propius penetrare posset, figura Bram celeriter evanuit, in nihilum dissolvens.

source: “As the Demoness of Pleasure concluded the ritual, she clicked her tongue and addressed Lumian, “The Andariel family’s state is dire. Even the patriarch can be offered as a sacrifice. Are they fully controlled by the Rose School of Thought?”
target: “Dum Demonissa Voluptatis ritum concludebat, linguae sonitum edidit atque Lumiano addixit: ‘Status familiae Andariel periculosus est. Etiam paterfamilias sacrificio offeri potest. Plenene ab Schola Rosi Cogitationis dominantur?’

source: “In light of the temperance faction’s alignment with the Church of The Fool within the Rose School of Thought, Franca glossed over distinctions between factions.
target: “Propter consociationem factionis temperantiae cum Ecclesia Stulti intra Schola Rosi Cogitationis, Franca differentias inter factiones neglectavit.

source: “After all, the Rose School likely teemed with adherents of indulgence.
target: “Postremo, Schola Rosi probabiliter abundabat sectatoribus indulgentiae.

source: “Lumian responded contemplatively, “The situation in the Abyss isn’t quite right either…”
target: “Lumian meditato animo respondit: ‘Res in Abyssu quoque non prorsus rectae sunt…’

source: “Whether Naboredisley was the pseudonym of Devil Monarch Farbauti or not, the plight of the blood-colored Demon deep within Hanth Island mirrored the Abyss’s troubles to some extent.
target: “Sive Naboredisley pseudonymum fuit Monarchi Diaboli Farbauti sive non, miseria daemonis sanguine tincti in fundo Insulae Hanth, ad aliquod modum difficultates Abyssi repraesentabat.

source: “With a scoff, Lumian remarked, “We’re accustomed to damning others to hell and the Abyss.
target: “Cum irrisu, Lumian dixit: ‘Consuevimus alios in infernum et Abyssum damnare.

source: “We believed it to be the worst place.
target: “Existimabamus illud esse locum pessimum.

source: “Who knew the Abyss itself could decay?
target: “Quis putavit Abyssum ipsum putrescere posse?

source: “It’s falling into its own abyss.”
target: “In proprium Abyssum suum cadit.”

source: “A hellish jest indeed.”
target: “Vere infernalis iocus est.”

source: “Franca glanced at the pristine night sky, less tainted by industrial pollution.
target: “Franca aspexit caelum nocturnum immaculatum, minus ab pollutione industriali corruptum.

source: “The crimson moon of the Southern Continent appeared clearer and brighter.
target: “Luna coccinea Continentis Australi clarius atque nitidiori apparuit.

source: “She steered the conversation back on track.
target: “Illa colloquium iterum ad viam rectam duxit.

source: “If Hisoka truly is from the Devil pathway, his actions make sense.
target: “Si Hisoka vere ex via Diaboli provenit, actus eius rationem habent.

source: “The Research Society was lax. Minimal filters or restrictions on its members…”
target: “Societas Inquisitrix levis erat. Filtra minima ac restrictiones in membris eius habebantur…

source: “Franca and Lumian were aware that the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society operated in a way that there were no Devil pathway Beyonders, but nobody knew the truth.
target: “Franca et Lumian sciebant Societatem Inquisitionis Simiarum Crispitarum ita operari ut nihil Beyonder viæ Diaboli adesset, sed veritatem nemo noverat.

source: “Membership didn’t entail self-declaration of pathways or proof.
target: “Membri non debebant se ipsos viarum declaratione aut testimonio ornare.

source: “Sequences were discerned through interactions at gatherings.
target: “Series per interactiones in conventibus discernebantur.

source: “Hisoka remained an enigma, his pathways and Sequence elusive even to key April Fool’s members.
target: “Hisoka remanebat enigma, viæ eius et series etiam membris principalibus Aprilis Stultorum elusae erant.

source: “Hisoka has always been a loner.
target: “Hisoka semper solitarius fuit.

source: “He rarely participates in other April Fool’s pranks.
target: “Raro in aliis iocis Aprilis Stultorum participat.

source: “Is he afraid of being discovered as a Devil?
target: “Num timet ut Diabolus detegatur?

source: “Lumian contemplated, adding, “He was most inclined to collaborate with Mad Lady, an unabashed lunatic who couldn’t care less.
target: “Lumian cogitavit, addens: ‘Valde inclinus erat ad collaborandum cum Mad Lady, lunatica absque pudore, quae nihil curabat.’

source: “She might even relish the prospect of testing if a Devil’s blood runs cold…
target: “Fortasse etiam delectabitur spe experiendi utrum sanguis diaboli frigescere possit…

source: “I sense a subtle mockery, insinuating my penchant for experimentation…
target: “Subtilis derisus mihi apparet, insinens meam cupiditatem experimentandi…

source: “Yet, despite being a Coldblooded, the remnant blood of the Serial Killer Bram retained a hint of warmth.
target: “Attamen, quamquam frigidus animo, reliquum sanguis Necatoris Serialis Bram levem caliditatis scintillam retinebat.

source: “Does Coldblooded mainly denote emotional detachment rather than literal coldness?
target: “Num ‘coldeblooded’ praecipue affectuum distantiam, potius quam literalem frigoris condicionem, significat?

source: “Or could it be the Southern Continent’s summer, heating up the blood of cold-blooded creatures… Franca’s musings drifted.
target: “An aestate Continentis Australi, quae sanguinem creaturarum frigidorum calefacit, hoc sit… cogitationes Francae pervolabant.

source: “Franca then cautioned Lumian, “If Hisoka is truly a Devil, he’ll sense your malice the moment you uncover a key clue.
target: “Franca deinde Lumiano monebat: ‘Si Hisoka vere Diabolus est, malitiam tuam sentiet in eodem momento quo clavem indicium detegas.’

source: “He can decide whether to strike or flee, shifting to another country to hide.
target: “Ipse decernere potest utrum percutiat aut fugiet, in aliam terram migrans ad latebandum.

source: “Dammit! Pursuing a Devil is a real hassle.
target: “Eheu! Diabolum persequi vere molestum est.

source: “When we can’t beat him, he strikes first.
target: “Cum eum vincere non possumus, prius ipse percutit.

source: “When we can, he’s nowhere to be found.
target: “Cum possumus, nusquam invenitur.

source: “We could use a Demon Hunter in times like these,” Lumian half-jokingly remarked.
target: “Lumian, paulo iocose dicens, addidit: ‘Indigeamus venatorem daemonum temporibus talibus.’

source: “From Devilology, Lumian knew that Sequence 4 of the Warrior pathway was the Demon Hunter—an expert in hunting Devils.
target: “Ex Devilologia, Lumian scivit Sequenciam Quartam viae Bellatoris esse Venatorem Daemonum—peritum in daemonibus venandis.

source: “They were natural adversaries to Devils, Desire Apostles, and even Demons.
target: “Hostes naturales erant Diaboli, Apostoli Desiderii, et etiam Daemones.

source: “One of the Demon Hunters’ crucial skills was concealing their actions and intentions, making it impossible for targets capable of sensing danger to detect them!
target: “Una inter artibus vitalibus Venatorum Daemonum erat suos mores atque consilia celare, ita ut destinatores periculorum sentiendi eos detegere nequeant!

source: “Franca concurred succinctly, “Now I see why Madam Magician sent you the spirit world’s coordinates, instructing you to visit the New City of Silver and find Mr. Sun to eliminate the remaining corruption.
target: “Franca breviter assentata est: ‘Nunc intellego cur Magistra Magica tibi notitiae mundi spirituum misisset, te iubens ut Novam Urbem Argenteam visitares et Dominum Solem invenires ad reliquam corruptionem tollendam.’

source: “It’s dominated by the Warrior pathway and boasts many Demon Hunters.
target: “Ea via Bellatoris imperatur et plurimos Venatores Daemonum habet.

source: “Though enlisting a Demon Hunter throughout the entire process might strain our resources.
target: “Attamen, cum per totum processum Venatorem Daemonum adducere conemur, opes nostras fortasse onerabit.

source: “That was a genuine demigod!
target: “Ille vere semideus erat!

source: “While dealing with Hisoka was Lumian’s personal grudge, Major Arcana card holders would also take notice, given Hisoka’s potential alignment with that Celestial Worthy.
target: “Dum res cum Hisoka agendi iniuria personalis Lumiani erat, et possessores chartarum Major Arcana animadvertere incipiebant, quoniam Hisoka fortasse ad illam Dignitatem Caelestem pertinere poterit.

source: “Lumian chuckled.
target: “Lumian subridens ridet.

source: “No need for a Demon Hunter to intervene directly.
target: “Non opus est ut Venator Daemonum directe interveniat.

source: “I wonder if they can craft charms, potions, or items concealing malice.
target: “Miror an possint fabricare amuleta, potiones, aut res malitiam celantes.

source: “If so, we can spend a hefty sum through the Tarot Club’s connections to acquire them or engage in item exchange.
target: “Si vero ita est, ingentem pecuniae sumam per coniunctiones Tarot Club impendere possumus ut ea adipisci aut mercari valeamus.

source: “Start inquiring soon,” Franca advised.
target: “Mox inquirere incipias,” Franca monuit.

source: “If Hisoka is a Desire Apostle, be cautious.
target: “Si Hisoka apostolus Desiderii est, cave.

source: “You carry too many random items, and some mystical items have adverse effects on emotions and desires.
target: “Multa fortuita gereas, et quaedam mysticae res in affectus et desideria male operantur.

source: “He could detonate them, injuring you instantly…
target: “Illos detonare potest, te statim laedens…

source: “As she spoke, Franca’s lips trembled before she sealed them shut.
target: “Dum loquebatur, labia Francae tremuerunt antequam ea obstruxit.

source: “Lumian nodded solemnly, refraining from boasting about his Ascetic abilities.
target: “Lumian graviter annuit, abstinens se glorificare de facultatibus asceticis suis.

source: “Having recently endured an explosion of emotions and desires, he understood it was beyond the endurance of an Ascetic, causing physical damage to the brain.
target: “Nuper per explosionem affectuum et desideriorum passi, intellexit id esse ultra tolerantiam asceticorum, damnum vero cerebri inferens.

source: “Franca then said, “The one chasing the Serial Killer was from the Numinous Episcopate, not a regular patrol member.
target: “Franca deinde dixit: ‘Qui Necatorem Serialem insequebat, ex Episcopato Numinoso erat, non ex ordinario membro vigilantiae.’

source: “The currents in Matani run deep.
target: “Cursus in Matani profundi sunt.

source: “The Numinous Episcopate, a clandestine organization in the Southern Continent, was rumored to trace its origins to the former royal descendants of the Balam Empire and Beyonders unwilling to forsake Death as their faith.
target: “Episcopatus Numinosus, organization secreta in Continentis Australi, fertur originem suam trahere ex regia posteritate olim Balam Imperii et Beyonder, qui Mortem ut fidem suam non deseruerunt.

source: “Their ultimate aim was to restore Death to His throne, ruling East and West Balam once more.
target: “Finis eorum ultimus erat Mortem throno suo restituere, regnantes Orientem et Occidentem Balam iterum.

source: “Lumian strolled to the window, gazing at the street.
target: “Lumian ad fenestram ambulavit, viam contemplans.

source: “He grinned and commented, "This is the chaotic Southern Continent."
target: “Ille subridens dixit: ‘Hoc est Continentum Australe chaos.’

source: “Actually, what piques my interest is why the Rose School of Thought is collecting information about the daily lives of Port Pylos residents.
target: “Revera, quod mihi maxime interest, est cur Schola Rosi Cogitationis notitias de vitae cotidianis in Portu Pylos colligat.

source: “It seems like they want to govern this place.
target: “Videtur quod hunc locum regere velint.

source: “That’s not their usual style.
target: “Non est hoc more solito eorum.

source: “Lumian had limited knowledge of the Rose School of Thought’s past.
target: “Lumian parum de praeteritis Scholae Rosi Cogitationis noverat.

source: “All he knew was their recent spree of sacrifices, leaving bloodshed wherever they occupied.
target: “Omnia quae noverat erant erant recentes sacrificia eorum, sanguinis effusio ubique, ubi insederunt.

source: “Running a city or port for extended periods didn’t align with their usual behavior.
target: “Regere urbem aut portum per longos tempora non conveniebat more eorum.

source: “Nothing is certain.
target: “Nihil certum est.

source: “Franca’s mind was working overtime recently.
target: “Mente Francae nuper extra modum laborabat.

source: “After a moment’s reflection, she added, “Regardless of the Rose School of Thought’s motives, considering the sacrifices they’ve conducted in recent years, they should have gained substantial boons from the Mother Tree of Desire.
target: “Post parvum meditando, addidit: ‘Quocumque sint causae Scholae Rosi Cogitationis, consideratis sacrificiis nuper factis, magnam fortasse beneficia a Matre Arboris Desiderii adepti esse debent.’

source: “Now, with Devil family members in the mix, encountering a significant Rose School of Thought member may mean dealing with a dual Bearer of potions and boons.
target: “Iam, cum membra familiae Diabolicae admixta sint, congressus cum membro significativo Scholae Rosi Cogitationis posse significat tractare duplicem feritorem potionum et opum.

source: “Perhaps a Zombie Recipient, Wraith Tree Spirit, or Sex Addict Apostle? Similar to a Hunter Monk like you.
target: “Fortasse recipientem zombiorum, spiritum arborum umbratilis, aut apostolum voluptatis addictum? Simile venatori monacho ut tu.

source: “Franca, always more adept at nicknames and unconventional thoughts than Lumian, playfully referred to Beyonders who were both Zombies and Recipients as Zombie Recipients.
target: “Franca, semper callidior in cognominibus et cogitationibus insolitis quam Lumian, ludicre Beyonder, qui et zombii et recipientes erant, ‘Zombie Recipients’ nominavit.

source: “Her primary intention was to caution Lumian that certain Rose School of Thought members might exploit abilities like those of the Sex Addict to provoke his desires.
target: “Scopum eius erat Lumiano monere ne quaedam membra Scholae Rosi Cogitationis facultates similes ut operam voluptatis addicti ad desideria eius provocanda utantur.

source: “Later, in their Desire Apostle form, they could detonate those desires, providing end-to-end service.
target: “Postea, in forma Apostolorum Desiderii, illa desideria detonare possent, servitium ex initio ad finem praebentes.

source: “It would be a formidable challenge.
target: “Id esset provocatione formidabilis.

source: “In Lumian’s condition, facing such Beyonders posed considerable danger.
target: “In condicione Lumiani, opposuisse talibus Beyonder periculum notabile exhibebat.

source: “Lumian chuckled, somewhat self-deprecatingly.
target: “Lumian, aliquantulum se dedecorans, subridens ridet.

source: “Why do I feel like a powder keg, ready to explode with the slightest touch?
target: “Cur me sentio quasi pyxis pulveris, paratus ad explosionem minimo tactu?

source: “Nevertheless, I don’t intend to meddle in the Rose School of Thought’s affairs.
target: “Attamen, non mihi consilium est res Scholae Rosi Cogitationis immiscere.

source: “I’ll write to Madam Magician and report the traces of the Rose School of Thought in Port Pylos.
target: “Scribam Magistrae Magicae et referam vestigia Scholae Rosi Cogitationis in Portu Pylos.

source: “Someone will investigate and handle it.
target: “Aliquis id investigabit et curabit.

source: “Aren’t Mr. Star and Mr. Moon among the Major Arcana card holders overseeing the Rose School of Thought?
target: “Nonne Domini Stella et Luna sunt inter possessores chartarum Major Arcana, qui Scholae Rosi Cogitationis superintendunt?

source: “My sole focus is Hisoka.
target: “Unicum propositum mihi est Hisoka.

source: “At least, we can be sure that even if he’s of the Devil pathway, he likely has no connection to the Andariel family.
target: “Saltem scimus etiam, si ex via Diaboli proveniat, eum verisimiliter nullam convenientiam cum familia Andariel habere.

source: “Otherwise, the Rose School of Thought wouldn’t have dispatched Bram and company for reconnaissance.
target: “Aliter, Schola Rosi Cogitationis Bram et comitatu non misisset ad speculandum.

source: “Bram wouldn’t have been oblivious if a family member had been active here.
target: “Bram non esset inscius, nisi membrum familiae hic activum fuisset.

source: “Franca hesitated for a moment before adding, “Hmm, just be careful.”
target: “Franca paulisper vacillavit, tum addidit: ‘Hmm, modo cave.’

source: “Having escorted Franca back to Trier, Lumian stowed away Bram’s Serial Killer Beyonder characteristic.
target: “Francam ad Treveros comitatus, Lumian proprietatem Necatoris Serialis Bram Beyonder recondidit.

source: “It took the form of a sharp-edged, prismatic ice cube, enveloping faint wisps of thin black gas.
target: “Id assumpsit formam cubi glacies acutissimi, prismatici, tenuas nebulae nigri gas involvens.

source: “Upon reaching Hotel Orella, Lumian approached the trio of mechanical elevators, pulled the handle, and stood patiently.
target: “Ad Hotel Orella perventus, Lumian ad trium machinarum elevatorum accessit, manubrium traxit, et patienter stetit.

source: “With a creak, the double doors opened simultaneously.
target: “Cum stridore, ostia duplicia simul aperta sunt.

source: “Lumian’s silhouette, elongated by the crystal chandelier behind him, was mirrored in the mechanical lift.
target: “Figura Lumiani, ab candelabro crystallino post eum elongata, in machinali elevatori reflecta erat.

source: “Beside him stood a slender human shadow.
target: “Iuxta eum stabat umbra humana gracilis.
